obfuscation_indicators: no assurance recovery will be sustained
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and transparent, with extensive quantified performance data and explanations of revenue and cost drivers. Risk tone is cautiously positive due to strong 2021 growth, but pandemic uncertainty, advertising sustainability, supply-chain disruptions, labor shortages, and changing consumer behavior remain material risks. Extensive caveats and non-GAAP presentations modestly increase interpretive complexity.
